correctness.rationale: Local prime powers are defined from the primary exact formula; removable-singularity Taylor expansions yield L1=x/2+(kappa-5)x^2/24+O(x^3) and L2=x+O(x^3), verified symbolically and consistent with the original published ratio expansion. At any large p, local comparison with a=0 and 2 gives (s,t]; the strict upper factor Q(p^a)<p/(p-1) controls all a>=3 because s asymptotically doubles the required tail cutoff. Smooth differentiation of the analytic x-series makes T strictly decreasing with derivative -(1+o)/(2p^2 log p), allowing an intersection-of-windows proof of uniform diameter (kappa-5)/6+o. Every fixed p has Q(p^2)>Q(p), so singleton primes diverge for epsilon tending to zero. All quantified assertions use fixed kappa>5. The numerical verifier tests representative local values but is not the universal proof.

value.rationale: Determines previously unquantified arithmetic geometry of prime-exponent-one events for a natural normalized reciprocal LCM extremizer sequence used to transfer Robin-scale bounds. The sharp asymptotic window width and joint window intersection yield the structural uniform boundedness and a new clean phase 5<kappa<17 in which exactly-one events occur infinitely often but multiple singletons ultimately disappear. This is more than checking a small parameter or translating the known kappa=5 sign.
